## Biography

Nishi is an undergraduate student majoring in Psychology and Neuroscience. She is very passionate about working with children and has a research focus on childhood development. In the future, Nishi hopes to attend medical school and become a pediatric psychiatrist. Outside of academics, Nishi loves to explore the city with friends and listen to music.
